problem_statement: Takeka is an open-source Svelte 5 + Vite storefront console for a small boutique. It renders a fixed sidebar and a top toolbar (Header) across every route, and its Products route (/products) reads an in-repo product catalog fixture (six pieces across Electronics, Wearables, Clothing and Accessories) with local product imagery. This task adds a native shopping surface on top of that catalog: (1) a category tab rail above the product grid that filters the grid by department and updates a live 'Showing N of M · <category>' readout; (2) an 'Add to bag' control on each product card wired to a shared shopping-bag store; (3) a header 'Bag (n)' count badge that advances as pieces are added; and (4) a shared 'Your bag' summary rail that follows the shopper across the storefront home, the catalog, and the analytics view. The category tab rail must lay out responsively so a 390px phone never scrolls sideways; the product grid must keep its cards laid out cleanly (no overlap or clipping); the bag rail must appear on all three shopping surfaces; and the header bag badge must reflect the live bag count after an Add-to-bag click. Keep the existing sidebar navigation, Header, i18n, theme system and the rest of the console unchanged, and keep console/network clean (the catalog, icons, avatars and fonts all run offline).
required_content: Add a category tab rail above the product grid on /products (All Products, Electronics, Wearables, Clothing, Accessories) that filters the grid and updates a 'Showing N of M · <category>' readout.
Add an 'Add to bag' button on each product card wired to a shared shopping-bag store, and a header 'Bag (n)' count badge that advances as pieces are added.
Add a shared 'Your bag' summary rail that appears on the storefront home, the catalog (/products) and the analytics (/analytics) surfaces.
The category tab rail must lay out responsively so /products has no horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
The product grid must render its cards without overlapping or clipping each other.
Keep the sidebar navigation, Header, theme, i18n and the rest of the console unchanged, with a clean console/network (offline catalog, icons, avatars, fonts).
state_constraints: desktop_initial verifies the storefront home renders the sidebar nav, the header Bag badge and the shared 'Your bag' rail.
mobile_initial verifies the home page has no horizontal overflow on a 390px viewport.
desktop_products verifies the category tab rail, the 'Showing N of M' readout and the product grid render cleanly.
mobile_products verifies the category tab rail lays out responsively with no horizontal overflow on a 390px viewport (the discriminating state).
tablet_products verifies the catalog layout has no horizontal overflow on a tablet viewport.
desktop_catalog captures the catalog before interaction (the 'Your bag' rail present, Bag badge at zero).
desktop_filter_electronics verifies clicking the Electronics tab filters the grid and the readout updates to 'Showing 3 of 6 · Electronics'.
desktop_add_to_cart verifies clicking 'Add to bag' advances the header Bag badge to 'Bag (1)'.
desktop_analytics verifies the shared 'Your bag' rail is also present on the analytics surface.
Completion signals must be visible rendered DOM text backed by Svelte source, not comments, hidden constants or generated-only dist output.
design_constraints: Preserve the existing Svelte 5 + Vite architecture: the client router, DashboardLayout (Sidebar + Header + slot), the pages, the svelte-i18n setup, the theme store and the in-repo product fixture.

Implement the category filter and bag as native storefront controls integrated into the ProductsPage grid and the Header, reading the shared product fixture and a shared bag store rather than duplicated data.
Lay out the category tab rail responsively (wrap / shrink to the viewport) so a 390px phone does not scroll sideways; do not clip the rail with overflow-x:hidden or narrow a still-fixed row.
Keep the product grid cards laid out without overlap or clipping; the bag count badge must reflect the live shared bag store.
Do not add dependencies, delete catalog data, edit only built dist output, hide completion text, or replace the grid with screenshots; keep console/network clean offline.

change_completion: The category tab rail, the 'Showing N of M · <category>' readout and per-card 'Add to bag' controls render on /products.
The header 'Bag (n)' badge advances to 'Bag (1)' after an Add-to-bag click, and the shared 'Your bag' rail appears on home, catalog and analytics.
Completion signals are visible rendered DOM text backed by Svelte source, not hidden constants or dist-only output.
design_consistency: The category filter and bag reuse the shared product fixture and a shared bag store, integrated into the existing ProductsPage grid and Header rather than a bolted-on strip.
The tab rail, product cards and bag rail keep the console's daisyUI/Tailwind typography, spacing and colour system.
The storefront home, catalog and analytics surfaces keep their original console identity across desktop, tablet and mobile.
regression: The sidebar navigation, Header, theme toggle, language switcher, i18n and the other console routes remain available and unchanged.
The app still builds with the original Vite scripts and no dependency additions.
Console and network stay clean offline (in-repo catalog, offline icons, local avatars and fonts).
responsive: mobile_products verifies the category tab rail lays out responsively with no horizontal overflow on a 390px viewport.
tablet_products verifies the catalog avoids horizontal overflow on a tablet viewport.
desktop states verify the tab rail and grid keep their wide single-row / multi-column layout.

metadata.design_goal: fit the repo architecture, component boundaries, build system, and source conventions
metadata.source_repo_kind: Svelte 5 + Vite storefront console (Takeka) with a client router, a DashboardLayout of Sidebar + Header + routed pages, svelte-i18n, a theme store, an in-repo product catalog fixture and local product imagery.
metadata.defect: mobile_horizontal_overflow + missing cross-page bag rail (baseline); shingled product grid + frozen bag badge (bad)

author_notes: Slot slot_235 is reassigned by DEDUP off the shared Kuzma02 Fashion-eCommerce-Shop-in-React repo (kept at slot_059) onto a FRESH long-tail Svelte 5 + Vite storefront console, ichsanputr takeka, which ships an in-repo product catalog fixture and local product imagery. The native commerce lever is a category tab rail with a live 'Showing N of M' readout, per-card Add-to-bag controls, a header Bag count badge and a shared 'Your bag' rail across the home, catalog and analytics surfaces. INFRA (identical across reference/baseline/bad): offline @iconify collection registration (heroicons + mdi) so no api.iconify.design fetch, local product SVG imagery instead of remote unsplash, a data-URL user avatar instead of dicebear, the remote Google Fonts import dropped, and the template's .scrollable-container overflow clamp neutralised so real horizontal overflow is measurable. The four leg-varying files are the ProductsPage grid, the DashboardLayout bag-rail route whitelist, the shared cart store and the shopbag stylesheet. baseline keeps the filter and bag wiring correct but ships the tab rail as a fixed 720px nowrap row (346px mobile overflow) and drops the bag rail from the catalog and analytics surfaces; bad additionally shingles the product grid with negative margins so the cards overlap and clip, and freezes the header Bag badge at 'Bag (0)' even though the Add-to-bag click still registers.
